title: Effect of SPS sintering temperature on the microstructure and mechanical properties of the WNbTaVTi refractory high entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by ball milling high-purity W, Nb, Ta, V, and Ti powders for 24 h with a ball-to-powder ratio of 5:1 at 300 rpm, followed by spark plasma sintering at 30 MPa pressure and temperatures of 1400, 1500, or 1600 °C for 5 min after holding at 1200 °C for 10 min.
